messages:
laura: Quick q — manager submitted an out-of-cycle comp increase (~10%) for an IC taking on new responsibilities. What's the approval path and what evidence do we need?
omar: Ops side: manager submits the comp-change form and then requests approval up their chain. attach evidence doc + cost center. form: https://redwood-internal/forms/comp-change
ben: Finance requires ECD (expected change date), annual run-rate delta, cost center, justification. People Ops signoff required before payroll. >$12k/yr run-rate escalates to Director+ and Finance review.
maria: Form asks for "sign-off matrix"  who signs if this bumps someone across grade boundaries?
samuel: If crossing grade boundary: manager -> manager's manager -> People Ops. Thresholds: >$12k director; >$25k exec. Also include promo evidence: short bullets describing new responsibilities + examples.
maria: Do we do this in Workday or only via the form? manager is unclear where to upload attachments.
omar: Intake is the form; it spawns a Workday task. Attach evidence on the form and upload a copy in the Workday request as well. For urgent changes add "PRIORITY" and ping @people-ops-review in Slack.
laura: Can we do retroactive pay back to the new role start date?
ben: Retro pay is exceptional. CFO + People Ops approval required. Finance prefers retro <= 60 days; anything larger needs strong justification and will be escalated.
maria: We're aiming for the next payroll (target Apr 30). Is that realistic?
samuel: If approvals complete today, Finance can usually hit the next payroll, but plan ~10 business days. Include cost code and HRIS employee ID to avoid delays.
maria: Separate Q: equity refresh — combine with comp change or separate process?
laura: Equity handled by comp-ops; do not mix with comp-change form. I'll loop in comp-ops for Maria.
jen-bot: Checklist: 1) Submit comp-change form (https://redwood-internal/forms/comp-change) 2) Attach manager rationale + evidence 3) Manager-manager approval 4) Finance allocates cost code 5) People Ops signoff 6) Tag PRIORITY for time-sensitive requests. Playbook: https://redwood-internal/playbooks/comp-change
omar: I'll DM the form walkthrough to Maria. @samuel do we have an evidence template?
samuel: Use "promo-evidence-template-v2" in Drive (I'll post link to #docs shortly). includes bullets for scope, impact, stakeholders, and examples.
maria: Thanks all — I'll resubmit with evidence and priority. :heart:
laura: Tagging for follow-up; reply here if you hit blockers and we'll coordinate.
